name: Indombe
body:
INDOMBE
CR 9

A titanic serpent, its yard-wide body coiling and tangling upon itself, stretching to an unfathomable length. Gleaming copper scales glow with the crimson fire of a dying sunset.

XP 6,400
N Gargantuan aberration
Init +7; Senses blindsight 60 ft.; Perception +26

DEFENSE

AC 23, touch 10, flat-footed 19 (+3 Dex, +1 dodge, +13 natural, –4 size)
hp 119 (14d8+56)
Fort +8, Ref +7, Will +12
DR 10/magic; Immune fire

OFFENSE

Speed 30 ft., climb 30 ft.
Melee bite +17 (2d8+15 plus 2d6 fire)
Space 20 ft.; Reach 15 ft.
Special Attacks entwining coils, inner heat (1d6+7 fire), constrict (2d8+15 plus 2d6 fire)

STATISTICS

Str 30, Dex 17, Con 19, Int 12, Wis 16, Cha 13
Base Atk +10; CMB +24 (+28 grapple); CMD 38 (40 vs. grapple, can’t be tripped)
Feats Dodge, Greater Grapple, Improved Grapple, Improved Initiative, Power Attack, Skill Focus (Perception), Weapon Focus (bite)
Skills Acrobatics +20, Climb +35, Perception +26, Stealth +8, Swim +27
Languages Common
SQ soul reborn

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Entwining Coils (Ex)

As a standard action, the indombe lashes out with its long coils attempting to grapple multiple creatures within its reach. It can attempt to grapple up to two creatures one size category smaller than itself (two Huge creatures), or up to four creatures two or more size categories smaller than itself (four creatures of Large-size or smaller). In addition, the indombe can take the Improved Grapple and Greater Grapple feats without having to meet their prerequisites.

Inner Heat (Su)

Any creature that hits an indombe with a melee weapon or natural attack takes 1d6+7 fire damage. Creatures wielding melee weapons with reach are not subject to this damage.

Spirit Reborn (Su)

When an indombe is reduced below 0 hit points, its body withers to dust and it is reborn as an indombe spirit. This spirit is friendly and cooperative, regardless of the indombe’s disposition when alive, and offers to help those it previously fought, displaying the cyclical nature of existence and the indombe’s role as a symbol of transformation and renewal.

Indombe Spirit: The spirit doesn’t attack, and if attacked has: AC 11, touch 11, flat-footed 7; hp 60; Defensive Abilities incorporeal; Immune undead traits; Speed fly 30 (perfect), and no longer has the inner heat ability. If unable to convince its former foes of its intentions or repeatedly attacked, the indombe spirit vanishes into the afterlife. The indombe spirit can provide mystical assistance to solve a particular problem. This comes in the form of spells of up to 7th.

ECOLOGY

Environment warm forests and jungles
Organization solitary or pair
Treasure incidental

GM’s Note

As a serpent-like being dwelling in the trees of the Congo, Indombe is a unique titanic serpent whose yard-thick body stretches several miles in length. She represents the intricate connection between the natural and spiritual realms, a central theme in Bakongo cosmology.

With her majestic form coiled through the trees, Indombe embodies both the beauty and the power of the natural world, inspiring a mix of fear and reverence in those who encounter her. Indombe stands as a powerful symbol of the enduring cultural values of the Bakongo people, weaving together themes of nature, spirituality, and the cyclical nature of existence in her role as a guardian of the natural world and a symbol of transformation and renewal level, even those with expensive material components, up to a total of 5,000 gp. The indombe spirit draws these spells from benevolent forces in the spirit world. These can include arcane and divine spells, but destructive or evil spells or those that create undead are not permitted. Examples include: find the path, greater restoration, greater scrying, legend lore, limited wish, and raise dead. The indombe spirit’s presence in this world is fleeting and its gift of spells must be received without undue delay; this can’t be saved for later use. After providing aid, the indombe spirit speaks its final words and passes into the great beyond.

Indombe are massive serpent-like beings which dwell among the tallest trees of dense woodlands and high jungle canopies. Their bodies shine with a vibrant copper hue, reflecting sunlight and appearing almost flame-like, with scales that shimmer and glow red from the heat within.

Despite the intense temperatures they generate, indombes cause little harm to surrounding vegetation.

A mature indombe’s body measures roughly three feet in width, but their length is extraordinary. Adults easily exceed 100 feet, and legends speak of a great Indombe Mother whose body stretched for miles.

The presence of an indombe evokes awe, reverence, and fear among those who live nearby. The indombe is regarded as an agent of transfiguration and resurgence. Their glowing scales are seen as a symbolic link to the sun, and the indombes’ influence is understood to touch both nature and spirit. Indombes are believed to bridge the natural and spiritual realms, embodying the cycle of life and death and the ideal of harmony with the environment. Upon death, an indombe is said to become a guardian spirit, continuing to watch over the living.
